name: clean-development
description: Storage routing (4TB external or internal fallback), the 5 GB rule, session-end cleanup and the no-dot-folder policy for G's Mac. Hooks are installed in user settings, not by this plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Storage routing and cleanup on this Mac
interface.longDescription: Where caches, builds, scratch, models and VMs go on this Mac, the 5 GB rule when the 4TB is absent, automatic session-end cleanup and the no-dot-folder policy. Hooks live in ~/.codex/hooks.json.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Clean Development for storage, download-size and cleanup decisions.
